questions.html:
Consider the following statements:
S1 : As the value of α increases, the acceptance region in a hypothesis test decreases.
S2 : The rejection region increases as α increases.
Which of the following is true?
questions.solution:
(c)
When the significance level α increases, the rejection region becomes larger because we are more wiling to reject the null hypothesis. As a result, the acceptance region becomes smaller. So, both statements are correct and describe the same inverse relation between α and the acceptance region.

Consider the following statements:
S1 : The null hypothesis is always rejected if the p-value is less than the significance level.
S2 : A one-tailed test can only test for deviations in one direction (either greater than or less than).
Which of the following is true?
questions.solution:
(b)
• If the p-value is less than the significance level, we reject the null hypothesis. However, we do
not always reject it — this is just the decision rule. So, S1 is false.
• A one-tailed test only tests for deviations in one direction, either greater than or less than.
So, S2 is true.
